svg.title: X11 - Molex Mini50 12-ckt SMT header, polarization option A - mating face wireframe
svg.desc: Front (mating-face) view of the Molex Mini50 12-circuit SMT header (series 34897), polarization option A. Geometry and dimensions are the Molex drawing SD-34897-001 rev W12, sheet 2.
svg.text: X11 — Molex Mini50 12-circuit SMT header · polarization option A
Mating-face (front) view · A11 Radio (IOK) · Molex series 34897, drawing SD-34897-001 rev W12 · geometry and dimensions from sheet 2
The key-slot position and the left/right wall steps differ between
options A, B and C on sheet 1 of the Molex drawing.
Pins 1-4: top row. Pins 5-12: bottom row.
Number sits to the right of its contact.
Ring around a contact = used (GM manual / design owner).
? = not known. Pins 1-2, 5-7, 10 from the design owner.
Header data — from the Molex drawing
Shroud: SPS 30% GF · blades: brass, Ni / Sn
Source: Molex SD-34897-001 rev W12, sheet 2 (front view with dimensions) — the geometry above is the manufacturer's own vector drawing, redrawn in black on white. Balloons 1, 2, 2A, 3 and
Pin centres were measured on that drawing: 2.00 mm pitch (per drawing); row separation ≈2.2 mm and first-contact offset ≈6.6 mm are measured values, not dimensioned by Molex. Option A
